# Source Sans 3 CFF integration fixture

`SourceSans3-Regular.otf` is the unmodified Adobe Source Sans 3 Regular font,
release **3.052R**, licensed under SIL Open Font License 1.1. `OFL.txt` is the
verbatim upstream license. The fixture is included only by tests; it is not a
bundled renderer font.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans>
- Pinned commit: `ed1808970eb3c7301c9a523bee26473ba0bb62fa`
- Font: <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans/ed1808970eb3c7301c9a523bee26473ba0bb62fa/OTF/SourceSans3-Regular.otf>
- License: <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans/ed1808970eb3c7301c9a523bee26473ba0bb62fa/LICENSE.md>
- Font SHA-256: `08df266400933d3178d081a45f94a08814c3e55b4b7dd2e0ff69cb1329f13ab6`
- License SHA-256: `89ad2c4f66dd29127527493e729c31e731f111cf10faf5774c3db9275ed0c22c`

The font has name-keyed CFF1 outlines, 2,478 glyphs, and 1,614 Unicode cmap
entries spanning Latin, Greek, and Cyrillic. It exercises ordinary text, cubic
curves, composite accents, and subsets exceeding a single-byte encoding.
